_comment: Copy to private/personal_config.json (gitignored). `VISIONALVR_PERSONAL=1 python3 harness/run.py build ... package` then ships these values in the portable folder (zip suffix -personal). Dotted keys are set inside session.default.json; `visionalvr` becomes config\visionalvr.json (the host/GUI settings). Not for GitHub releases. `session_merge` is deep-merged into session.default.json (the paired headset: an entry with an empty hostname is a headset added by IP address); `visionalvr.headset` is the headset the runtime window connects to without asking. `extra_files` are files on the build PC copied next to VisionALVR.exe in the package (your launcher .bat and the tools it calls).
